selection_reasoning: The task 'find blast_furnace' is a single atomic task that is well-suited for a benchmark: it requires the agent to visually explore a Minecraft environment and locate a specific block (blast furnace). It is observable and verifiable — the agent must navigate to and look at the blast furnace. It doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, just spatial navigation and visual recognition. Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, there are no dependency edges, but the task itself is a clear, self-contained objective that can be placed in a designed scene with varying difficulty (e.g., the blast furnace can be placed inside a structure the agent must enter and explore).

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the blast furnace and face toward it, modeling that they can visually observe it up close. The blast furnace is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 10) inside the stone brick building. max_distance=5 ensures the player must enter the building or stand at the entrance looking in (not just face the right direction from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking at the blast furnace.

scene_description: A compact stone brick blacksmith workshop placed directly in front of the player spawn. The building has a wide open entrance (3 blocks wide) facing the player, with torches at the base and a cobblestone path leading to it. Inside, the workshop contains a blast furnace at the center of the back wall (facing south toward the entrance), flanked by a crafting table and anvil. A barrel and cauldron are placed along the side walls. A hanging lantern provides interior illumination, and glass pane windows are set into the east and west walls. The area around the building is cleared of trees and foliage for easy navigation.
task_text: Find the blast furnace inside the stone brick workshop building ahead of you. Walk forward along the cobblestone path, enter through the open entrance, and locate the blast furnace at the back wall.
design_notes: Building centered on x=0 relative to spawn, extending from z=5 to z=11. Entrance at z=5 (south face), blast furnace at z=10 (back wall center). Cobblestone path from z=1 to z=4 leads directly to entrance. 24-block area cleared of trees/foliage. Interior is 5x5 (from x=-2 to x=2, z=6 to z=10). Blast furnace faces south so its distinctive front texture is visible when entering. Hanging lantern at ceiling center for interior lighting.
